description: Composition policy for any asset whose authored construction graph contains a primary_volume. Currently a no-op expansion: it serves as the smoke-test policy that proves the pipeline matches preconditions and applies policies correctly. Future revisions add structural expansions (e.g., panel-on-major-face, fastener-on-corners). The policy is non-family-keyed by design — it applies to any hard-surface asset with a primary_volume, regardless of whether that asset is a crate, door, terminal, cabinet, or anything else.
